title: Graduate Engineering Officer
apply_instructions: Apply via www.cgg.wa.gov.au/employment/ with resume and written responses to six selection criteria (max 1250 characters each). Close 4pm Thursday 15 October 2026. Contact Chris Edwards, Manager Project Delivery and Engineering, (08) 9956 6949.
rationale: Advert ideally wants a Degree in Civil Engineering or Design (or progressing); Marc holds BSCE (Philippines) plus Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design (Feb 2026).
Role covers civil design, drafting, estimating, roads, stormwater and subdivision support; coursework covers road, earthworks, pavement, stormwater in Civil 3D and AutoCAD.
Regional WA location is acceptable under FIFO/regional availability; Main Roads WA standards are not on record as used on a job (criterion asks developing knowledge / aptitude).
caution: No Australian commercial council design experience; MRWA/IPWEA knowledge is coursework-level only; relocation to Geraldton needs Marc confirmation.
gaps: Main Roads WA guidelines used on a job
